newsitem.title: USA: Xerox cuts printer prices up to 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Xerox cuts printer prices up to 21 percent.

text.p: Xerox Corp. Monday reduced prices by up to 21 percent across its full line of desktop monochrome laser printers in the United States.
The aggressive pricing is part of a plan to support the newly created Xerox Channels Group, charged with quadrupling indirect channel sales to $4 billion in three years, it said.
Xerox, based in Stamford, Conn., also said it launched a major national advertising campaign, developed by Young & Rubicam, showcasing the DocuPrint C55 Colour Laser Printer.

Xerox's DocuPrint 4508 now has an estimated street price of about $549. The DocuPrint 4512 costs about $1,049, and the DocuPrint 4517, with "copier-like" paper-handling features and options, costs about $1,249.
